purpose: Adaptive source-pointer transport feasibility following preserved exact-copy failures. Five declared development cases exercise objectives, records, cross-publication comparison, source qualification and corpus-scoped refusal. This bundles a new positional transport and schema with the complete prompt; it is not a causal prompt-only comparison.
continuation_gate: Require no pointer/schema failure, inspect all visible claims and exports against supplied spans, and demonstrate at least one complete supported cross-publication comparison before a paired prompt pilot. Critical semantic failure requires focused diagnosis; no rerolls, final questions, outside facts or automatic selection.
revision_rationale: Source spans preserve every character and allow deterministic source-position selection. Canonical validation, semantic support, all required facts, qualifications and whole-answer veto are unchanged. This original I/O adaptation adds no runtime library; it extends the authorized numbered-passage approach. Schema mode is held on for the new raw pointer shape, not claimed to solve semantic quality.
